name: L10 PanoLab reciprocal three-frame top-two appearance router
question: Does a fixed top-two-of-three query score recover the frozen occlusion failure while preserving zero wrong-target candidates under the unchanged accept gate?

aggregation.sequence: Exact reciprocal prev, consumed anchor, exact reciprocal next.
aggregation.per_frame: Unchanged strict entrance-ray crop and 0.35 CLIP + 0.25 DINOv2 + 0.40 mutual-patch-geometry target score against the unchanged two-reference bank.
aggregation.per_target_sequence_score: Arithmetic mean of the highest two of the three per-frame target scores; deterministic ties by relation name.
aggregation.reason: Require two supporting observations while discarding one worst occluded frame. This is the only structural hypothesis; no sweep or learned sequence head.

accept_contract.source: Unchanged minima frozen from the original four consumed positives before both open-set and cross-collection panels.
accept_contract.rule: Emit SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY candidate only when the sequence aggregate has unique top-1 and meets both score and margin thresholds; otherwise UNKNOWN_KEEP_SEARCHING.
accept_contract.no_adaptation: No frame, crop, reference, feature weight, sequence length, top-two aggregation, threshold, or roster may change after either temporal result is observed.

required: two valid reciprocal three-frame query sequences
at least +1 correct over the frozen single-frame 1/2 baseline
0 wrong-target candidates across 10 counterfactual wrong-goal trials

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed posthoc Development evidence for or against a fixed reciprocal three-frame, top-two-mean query aggregation mechanism on exactly FP01 and FP02 in the six-target same-provider closed roster.
not_allowed: trained sequential descriptor performance or attribution to SeqNet, SeqVLAD, or JIST
provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment generalization
exact physical identity authority, pixel portal grounding, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
